LanguageData.wils.education.teaching_earn_help: Teach lessons and classes to earn teaching experience. Teaching a subject also builds experience toward its specialty.
LanguageData.wils.education.tutor_help: Offers one-to-one lessons when a suitable pupil is available.
LanguageData.wils.education.teacher_help: Teaches classes in a usable classroom, or individual lessons when no classroom is available.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_ClassesDisabled: Classes are switched off in mod settings.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_ClassQueued: A requested class is waiting for the next suitable opportunity.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_NoInstructorHere: No assigned instructor is currently available on a map. Tutors can still provide individual lessons.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_NoSuitablePupils: No suitable pupils were found on the instructors’ maps. A lesson needs a pupil who can learn a skill the instructor knows better.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_NoClassroom: No reachable classroom lectern was found for the current instructors. Individual lessons may still take place. An indoor lectern enables classes.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_ClassWaiting: Classes start when the instructor’s schedule, needs and suitable pupils allow. Select a classroom lectern to request a class.
